method.mrd: Embedded PPR text is parsed from the MRD (October 5 parser); dimensions and datatype from the binary header. FSE dimensions, ETL, thickness, offsets, gains and phase-mode records are cross-checked against oct12_load.load().
method.comparison: Protocol fields are compared after trimming acquisition arrays to each side's no_diff_acq and dropping acq_grad (inactive in b-input mode 1). Runtime-only AcquisitionStartTime, PerformanceCounterFrequency and END are excluded. Scanner records (gains, masks, delays) are reported separately; the planned PPRs carry none, so they appear as reference=null.
method.references: adjacent = PPR in the scan folder; planned = experiments/2026-10-12_exvivo_invivo_plan PPR of the same letter (MM uses M, Q1 uses Q, QQQ uses QQ); in-vivo scans use the closest plan letter U/V/W/X of the same PPL (fewest differing protocol fields, ties by shared (b, direction) rows then by volume count); planned_nav1_fallback = the doubled-letter fallback PPR; plan_named_in_adjacent_file = the plan PPR whose letter appears in the in-vivo folder PPR file name.
method.epi: EPI b-values and directions decoded from b_steps_array and diff_grad_dir (one x, y, z triplet per b-step, thousandths); btable.txt is compared separately. The raw EPI MRD has no_b_steps+1 experiments; the vendor _o.MRD holds no_b_steps experiments that align with raw experiments 1..n by mean magnitude.
method.slice_geometry: Edge-to-edge gap = z pitch of neighbouring FOV_OFFSETS minus slice thickness (gs_var, mm); negative = nominal overlap. The PPL positions slices from the FOV_SLICE_OFF DAC table, not from the SLICE_SEPARATION record; DAC per mm x thickness is 400 for every FSE slice.
method.counter: Hardware performance counter (10 MHz), relative chronology only; not a calendar timestamp. FSE and EPI MRDs share one counter frequency and are placed on one timeline.
method.source_identity: PPL paths are version labels only; the MRD carries no source-content hash.
